## Background

You can recreate the previous map task, or find your own spatial data to display using leaflet. Consider using layers and control boxes to show time or other aspects of the data.

## Task

1.  Choose an option:

    - Recreate a previous task visualization using a simple leaflet plot using R OR
    - Find your own spatial data that interests you and build a an interactive map using leaflet. You could experiment with using one (or both) of the two different kinds of layers.

2.  Write one to two paragraphs in the `.qmd` summarizing insights from your graphics and your data presentation choices.

3.  Render your `.qmd` file. Push all the files created in the rendering process into your GitHub repository.

### Submit

In I-learn submit the link to your `html` file hosted on your repo's GitHub pages.
